body.p: Hauwa Muhammad is an experienced Environmental and Climate Change expert, She obtained her first degree (B.Sc Geography) from the prestigious Gombe State University. She had her mandatory NYSC Service year in Federal polytechnic Bauchi, Department of Leisure and Tourism. She is currently a Masters research student at Abubakar Tafawa Balewa University in Environmental Management Technology specializing in Climate Change. Hauwa presently works in the Department of Climate Change, Gombe State Ministry of Water, Environment and Forest Resources as Senior Scientific Officer. She also plays the role and responsibility of Environmental Safeguard officer L-PRES Gombe.

Dr. Dauda Mishel is a dedicated, results-oriented Veterinarian and Livestock Extension Specialist with extensive experience in Livestock productivity, One Health, and Community-based Livestock initiatives. He is skilled at working with farmers, training livestock service providers, and implementing Livelihood programs in underserved communities. With a strong background in Project Management, Resource Planning, and Data Analysis, Dr. Dauda makes evidence-based decisions that enhance project outcomes. His leadership in managing multi-stakeholder projects, conducting needs assessments, and coordinating emergency and resilience programs has been pivotal in advancing rural development. Through his work with L-PRES, he continues to empower Livestock farmers, improve extension services, and promote resilient livestock while fostering Agricultural sustainability.

Mohammed Bukar Gadam is a professionally registered Animal Scientist. He holds an NCE from FCE(T) Gombe and a Bachelor’s degree from ATBU Bauchi. Gadam has over 20 years of experience in livestock development strategies, including attending several World Bank training programs on animal production.

Gadam has served as an Area Livestock Officer and service provider in Kwami, Funakaye, Nafada, and Dukku LGAs. He currently holds the position of Deputy Director at the Gombe State Ministry of Agriculture and Animal Husbandry. Additionally, Gadam manages the Gombe State Poultry Farm (PPU).
Throughout his career, Gadam has demonstrated a passion for providing services and advancing modern techniques in animal improvement.

Samir Shehu is an accomplished Civil Engineer with a decade of experience in engineering practice having worked with several companies handling various constructions in specialized as well as conventional civil engineering projects ranging from industrial structures, road constructions, sports as well as residential building constructions. He is a graduate of the Prestigious Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria and Currently works with the Gombe State L-PRES Project serving as the Project Engineer.

body.p: An innovative and results-oriented ICT professional with proven experience in software and mobile application development, digital transformation, ICT consultancy, data management, and technology-driven project implementation with professional memberships with the Nigerian Institute of Management (Chartered) and the Computer Professionals Registration Council of Nigeria (CPN). Ibrahim is a dedicated project photographer with over two years of hands-on experience capturing moments that matter. His work goes far beyond taking pictures—he brings a deep sense of purpose into every assignment. Whether he’s documenting community events, project milestones, or human-centered stories, Ibrahim approaches each shot with intention and clarity.

What sets him apart is his ability to transform simple images into powerful narratives. He doesn’t just photograph scenes; he interprets them. Through his lens, everyday activities become meaningful stories, and ordinary people become heroes of their own journeys. This storytelling gift has made his work stand out across the projects he has contributed to.

A natural genius behind the camera, Ibrahim blends creativity, technical skill, and emotional intelligence to deliver visuals that speak for themselves. His passion continues to grow with every project, pushing him to refine his craft and inspire others through the stories he captures.
